items.headline: Coastal Flood Watch issued November 24 at 5:51PM PST until November 26 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor to moderate
coastal flooding. For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking
waves of 6 to 11 feet with dangerous rip currents. For the
Coastal Flood Watch, significant coastal flooding possible.

* WHERE...Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 6 AM PST
Thursday. For the High Surf Advisory, from 10 AM Wednesday to
9 PM PST Thursday. For the Coastal Flood Watch, Thursday
morning.

* IMPACTS...There is a moderate risk for damaging flooding of
sea water over some vulnerable low-lying coastal areas,
especially around the time of high tide, including over
beaches (especially from Santa Monica to Palos Verdes and
Malibu), roads, and structures. Significant beach erosion is
possible. There is an increased risk for ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Large
breaking waves can cause injury, wash people off beaches and
rocks, and capsize small boats near shore. Extremely high
tides may cause dock damage and seawater spillage over low
lying areas inside of harbor areas (such as Naples in Long
Beach).

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Extremely high tides of 8.0-8.4 feet will
likely peak between 7am and 11am. An upgrade to a Coastal
Flood Warning would likely come by Tuesday. Coastal Flood and
High Surf Advisories are likely to follow the expiration of
the respective warnings if they are issued.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. Plan
for extra travel time as some roads may be closed.

Remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions, or stay
near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly in
such conditions, stay off the rocks.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 24 at 9:59PM PST until November 26 at 3:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Hazardous sea conditions.

* WHERE...Inner waters from Point Mugu to San Mateo Pt. CA
including Santa Catalina and Anacapa Islands.

* WHEN...From 3 AM to 3 PM PST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
